prompt: Create a dramatic vertical cinematic double-exposure movie poster featuring a beautiful young woman with black hair highlighted in purple and intense sharp hazel-brown eyes. In the background, place one enormous close-up portrait of her face filling most of the frame, slightly left-centered, with windblown messy hair spreading outward into black ink splashes, charcoal brush strokes, and subtle purple streaks. In the center foreground, show one full-body version of the same woman walking confidently toward the viewer, looking directly at the camera and pointing one finger outward; her other hand is tucked into her pants pocket. Dress her in an open black-and-white plaid overshirt, plain white T-shirt, loose off-white cargo pants, and dark sneakers with red accents. Use a moody gray background with grunge texture, smoky mist, and black paint splatter effects. Along the bottom, include a dark silhouetted pine forest line with fog and a wet reflective ground beneath her feet. The composition should feel intense, stylish, and poster-like, with high contrast, realistic photography, sharp facial detail, cinematic lighting, shallow depth, black-gray-purple color grading, and no visible title text or logos. Countable elements: exactly two depictions of the woman, one giant background face and one full-body foreground figure; exactly one pointing gesture; exactly one forest silhouette band at the bottom.
